sentences.en: He held off the attackers long enough for reinforcements to arrive.
sentences.zh: 他抵挡住攻击者足够长的时间，以便增援赶到。

sentences.en: The steel columns tend to be covered by concrete for reinforcement.
sentences.zh: 钢柱通常会被混凝土包裹以加固。

sentences.en: General Andrews sent for more reinforcements to stave off the enemy troops.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁斯将军派人调来更多增援部队以抵御敌军。

senses.zh: 援军;增援警力 (感情或思想等的)巩固,加强,强化
